sources.title: Diversity-Promoting Human Motion Interpolation via Conditional ...
sources.snippet: ABSTRACT In this paper, we present a deep generative model based method to generate diverse human motion interpolation results. We resort to the Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder (CVAE) to learn human motion conditioned on a pair of given start and end motions, by leveraging the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) structure for both the encoder and the decoder. sources.snippet: A Unified 3D Human Motion Synthesis Model via Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder Abstract: We present a unified and flexible framework to address the generalized problem of 3D motion synthesis that covers the tasks of motion prediction, completion, interpolation, and spatial-temporal recovery.
